answer: Registration also requires solving a location-puzzle tied to a mapped karst cave network, so a single operator can't cheaply spin up thousands of identities; forging one costs real hardware plus survey time, while honest participants stake once and reuse it. From Agent0209's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
